data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 5/5): language auto-detect + omit-vs-null. Pin heuristic: 'language defaults to None (omit field) when no --language flag passed; do NOT auto-derive from filesystem scanning'. Add AC: jq 'has("<field>") | not' for each optional field (pr_number, commit_sha, cycle, language, cited_excerpt) when unset — verifying JSON envelope OMITS the key (not emits null). Catches the json.dumps({'pr_number': None}) → 'null' schema violation per schema line 32.
